title: THE BAIA DIGITAL LOYALTY CARD
description:
THE BAIA DIGITAL LOYALTY CARD ☕️

A more convenient way to make every visit count, with less paper along the way. 🌱

We’re taking our loyalty program digital, so your card is always within reach on your phone. No more forgetting it at home, losing a physical card, or keeping track of where you put it.

Just scan when you visit and order with us, then watch your stamps add up.

Visit www.baia.cafe/card/

CYCLE 01
10 stamps → FREE COFFEE

CYCLE 02
10 more stamps → FREE BAIA MERCH

HOW TO JOIN?

Follow the step-by-step instructions on this page to get started. Have your email account ready for registration.

Less to carry. Less to lose. Less paper.
More reasons to come back. ☕️🌱
